description.description: The bookmark's description; null when it has none

folders.description: The names of the caller's folders the bookmark is filed in, sorted by the bytes of the name; each is the name of an entry of the document's folders

forwarding.description: Whether /go forwards to the bookmark by its slug; true only for a bookmark with a slug

planArchived.description: Whether a downgrade of the plan archived the bookmark: it is exported with everything else, flagged

ref.description: The export-local reference of the bookmark, `b1`, `b2` and so on in the order of the list; the entries of goPreferences name a bookmark by it

slug.description: The bookmark's slug; null when it has none

tags.description: The names of the caller's tags the bookmark carries, sorted by the bytes of the name; each is the name of an entry of the document's tags

url.description: The bookmark's address, an http or https URL, as it is stored

bookmarks.description: Every bookmark the caller owns, plan-archived ones included and flagged, in the order of their creation

exportedAt.description: When the export began, in UTC: the one timestamp the document holds

folders.description: Every folder the caller owns, used or not, sorted by the bytes of the name

format.description: Always slugbase-export: the document is a SlugBase export

goPreferences.description: The caller's remembered slug choices; always empty in this release

shared.description: The bookmarks other members shared with the caller; always empty in this release

tags.description: The name of every tag the caller owns, used or not, sorted by the bytes of the name

version.description: The version of the format; a reader refuses a version newer than it supports

name.description: The name of the workspace the content was exported from

color.description: The folder's colour, 1 to 8: the number of the --folder-N theme token

icon.description: The folder's icon, a lucide icon name

name.description: The folder's name, as the caller entered it
